name: Starship Inanna
source:
You take on the role of Commander Cargen, a human of the Titan Empire, who has just been assigned as second in command under Captain Zal, a human female. The crew of the ship is comprised of select races of the Empire which the player will be able to interact with and have relationships with (that means a lot of sex as the story continues). As Commander you will be sent on missions to different planets where you will encounter new cultures and civilizations.  You will run across slavers, enemy races, omnipotent beings, and more.

[From [url=http://starshipinanna.com/en/Game/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演泰坦帝国的人类指挥官卡根，刚被任命为女性舰长扎尔的副手。船员来自帝国的多个种族，玩家可以与他们互动并发展关系（随着故事推进，还会发生许多性爱）。

作为指挥官，你会被派往不同星球执行任务，遇见各种文化与文明。你将遭遇奴隶贩子、敌对种族、全能存在，以及更多危险。

[摘自[url=http://starshipinanna.com/en/Game/]官方网站[/url]]
